posts.text: Had a productive meeting with President U Min Aung Hlaing of Myanmar. We in India are honoured that he has chosen India for his first foreign visit as President. Our talks covered ways to deepen cooperation in trade, rare earths, healthcare, connectivity and capacity building.
posts.caption: Had a productive meeting with President U Min Aung Hlaing of Myanmar. We in India are honoured that he has chosen India for his first foreign visit as President. Our talks covered ways to deepen cooperation in trade, rare earths, healthcare, connectivity and capacity building.

posts.text: PM Modi held wide-ranging talks with Myanmar President U Min Aung Hlaing at Hyderabad House. Both leaders agreed to work closely in areas such as maritime security, cyber security and more. Myanmar assured its territory would not be used against India's security interests.
